payload.description_html:
Echinochimaera meltoni Lund, 1977 - fossil fish from the Mississippian of Montana, USA. (public display, Museum of the Rockies, Bozeman, Montana, USA)

Echinochimaera meltoni is a fossil holocephalian fish from estuarine deposits of the Late Mississippian-aged Bear Gulch Lagerstätte in Montana.

From museum signage: This spiny chimaera is related to modern chimaeras and ratfish. Antler-like scales and large fins were used to attract females and impress other males.

Classification: Animalia, Chordata, Vertebrata, Chondrichthyes, Holocephali, Chimaeriformes, Echinochimaeridae

Stratigraphy: Bear Gulch Limestone Member, Heath Formation, Upper Mississippian
